# Kati Sara — Permanent Makeup Studio, Ashkelon

> Kati Sara is a permanent makeup studio in Ashkelon, Israel (Balfour 31).
> Services: permanent makeup (eyeliner, lip powder method, eyebrow powder method),
> lash lamination, classic/2D/3D/5D volume lash extensions, tattoo removal (laser/Removery),
> professional makeup, bridal hair styling and makeup, deals and packages.
